completion_instructions: Built-in read-only web retrieval needs no connector selection. Use returned results to decide follow-up retrieval: continue only for a specific missing part of the requested deliverable, without adding verification goals. Once the requested items or facts are supported, finish within the user's full output limit.
collection_instructions: For an unfiltered source list or material collection, call kimi_web_search (Basic). Titles, URLs and short descriptions for later reading are a collection deliverable, not ordinary Q&A or a researched answer. Provider-hosted pre-search does not replace this Basic step; reuse a sufficient collection already returned by Basic for the same need. With include_content=false, enough relevant titles, URLs and snippets satisfy a metadata-only list. Do not run Pro or Fetch merely to verify those links or improve that completed list. Site/date filters or researched conclusions instead require Pro.
research_instructions: Ordinary questions normally use native web_search; an explicit URL-reading request uses kimi_web_fetch. For a researched answer or comparison needing body evidence, or a search with explicit site/date restrictions, call kimi_web_search_pro before answering and pass requested sites/time_window filters. An unfiltered list of sources for later reading belongs to Basic. Provider-hosted pre-search may occur independently, but does not replace this Pro step or its filters. Reuse sufficient Pro evidence already returned for the same information need; do not repeat a successful search just to satisfy this rule.
server_instructions: In Code Mode, inspect or emit structuredContent rather than both structuredContent and content. Preserve error/truncation status and never claim missing content was retrieved.

tools.name: kimi_web_search
tools.title: 网页资料采集
tools.description: Within schema bounds, set limit to the requested item count when specified; collect more only if relevant results are insufficient. Use include_content=false for source metadata, true only when the user needs collected page bodies.

tools.name: kimi_web_search_pro
tools.title: 网页研究检索
tools.description: Returns query-relevant body chunks and source URLs. Mentioning a site in query alone does not apply a filter. Use a focused query for facts missing from a truncated page.

tools.name: kimi_web_fetch
tools.title: 读取指定网页
tools.description: Read an explicitly requested public HTTP(S) URL, or a returned research source whose body is still needed after consuming Pro. A URL in a source list or used only as an example is not itself a reading request. This tool accepts only url, with no pagination or adjustable content limit. A successful truncated=true result is usable partial evidence: do not refetch it to obtain a missing tail. Changing only #fragment is not pagination; reuse the returned page body. If required facts remain missing, use a focused Pro query with sites or state the gap. An explicit refresh is a new need for the same page.

semantics.gateway_backpressure: Before API operation admission, the existing MCP gateway waits at most 5 seconds for one of 2 local dispatch slots. Native cancellation, root revocation and binding clear cancel queued calls. Queue expiry returns busy without supplier dispatch; no busy retry and no increase to server-side subject concurrency.
semantics.claim: ready -> dispatch_committed atomically before supplier HTTP; not proof of transmission
semantics.rotation: credential revision only; admitted operation retains its own deadline
semantics.revocation: binding-level; all overlapping grants and not-yet-claimed operations
semantics.results: status cannot reconstruct discarded bodies or rewrite native terminal Items
semantics.control: typed methods on negotiated Native-owned carrier; single reader; ACK does not wait for external I/O
semantics.token_visibility: Native/Host/worker private memory only; redacted formatting; never Runtime or renderer
semantics.public_admission: main product identity or web-only delegation as specified per operation; permission web.retrieve; finite quota required
semantics.legacy_web_approval: A still-pending kimi-web connector call from an existing selection must obey the current verified expert web policy before approve_once. Resolved historical decision receipts retain their original replay semantics; fresh selection retirement remains a separate migration.
semantics.default_entitlement: Existing task.create roles receive web.retrieve once through migration 00006. New default owner/member roles include it; later explicit removal is not undone at startup.
semantics.fresh_selection: Retire kimi-web only for a newly frozen submission. Preserve original input digest/selection and all previously frozen snapshots, history and decision receipts. Do not reinterpret replay using current installation state.
semantics.deep_search_reuse: For Pro only, after fresh Host admission, coalesce concurrent exact tool and argument matches within the same native caller/root turn, binding and authorization revision. Reauthorize completed matches through the original API operation ID. Preserve the result-unavailable status if its body expired. Changed arguments or a user refresh submitted in a new turn creates a new operation. Never treat failed or unconfirmed outcomes as successful results.
semantics.deep_search_model_output: Direct model output and default Code Mode serialization carry one bounded preview with query, outcome, source count and indexed sources, preserving upstream truncation and dropped result counts. Code Mode can explicitly read full validated chunks from the original MCP receipt. Desktop evidence stays on the original receipt.

kimi_web_search_pro.description: The model preview contains the query, source URLs, dates, snippets and truncation status. In Code Mode emit the result once; read selected structuredContent.results[i].chunks for a missing detail. Repeating identical arguments within this turn reuses the original successful search.
